function HoodieModel() {
	_s();
	if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
		window.__hoodieModelMount = (window.__hoodieModelMount || 0) + 1;
	}
	console.log("Rendering HoodieModel", window?.__hoodieModelMount);
	const obj = useLoader(OBJLoader, "/models/hoodie.obj");
	const group = useRef(null);
	const eased = useRef({
		x: 0,
		y: 0
	});
	useEffect(() => {
		const bbox = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(obj);
		const size = new THREE.Vector3();
		bbox.getSize(size);
		const center = new THREE.Vector3();
		bbox.getCenter(center);
		const maxAxis = Math.max(size.x, size.y, size.z);
		const scale = maxAxis > 0 ? 2.1 / maxAxis : 1;
		obj.position.sub(center);
		obj.scale.setScalar(scale);
		let meshCount = 0;
		obj.traverse((child) => {
			if (child.isMesh) {
				meshCount += 1;
				child.castShadow = true;
				child.receiveShadow = true;
				let material = child.material;
				if (!material) {
					material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
						color: "#e7e2d6",
						roughness: .6,
						metalness: .02,
						side: THREE.DoubleSide
					});
				} else if (Array.isArray(material)) {
					material = material.map((item) => {
						const clone = item.clone();
						clone.side = THREE.DoubleSide;
						return clone;
					});
				} else {
					material = material.clone();
					material.side = THREE.DoubleSide;
				}
				child.material = material;
			}
		});
		if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
			window.__hoodieDebug = {
				meshCount,
				bbox: {
					min: bbox.min.toArray(),
					max: bbox.max.toArray()
				},
				size: size.toArray(),
				center: center.toArray(),
				scale
			};
			console.log("HoodieModel loaded", window.__hoodieDebug);
		}
	}, [obj]);
	useFrame((state, delta) => {
		const { pointer, clock } = state;
		const targetY = pointer.x * .24;
		const targetX = pointer.y * -.12;
		const smoothing = Math.min(delta * 2.4, 1);
		eased.current.x += (targetX - eased.current.x) * smoothing;
		eased.current.y += (targetY - eased.current.y) * smoothing;
		if (group.current) {
			group.current.rotation.x = .16 + eased.current.x + Math.sin(clock.elapsedTime * .35) * .02;
			group.current.rotation.y = Math.PI + eased.current.y + Math.sin(clock.elapsedTime * .27) * .02;
			group.current.position.y = -.18 + Math.sin(clock.elapsedTime * .55) * .08;
		}
	});
	return /* @__PURE__ */ _jsxDEV("group", {
		ref: group,
		scale: [
			1.25,
			1.25,
			1.25
		],
		position: [
			0,
			-.9,
			0
		],
		children: /* @__PURE__ */ _jsxDEV("primitive", { object: obj }, void 0, false, {
			fileName: _jsxFileName,
			lineNumber: 90,
			columnNumber: 7
		}, this)
	}, void 0, false, {
		fileName: _jsxFileName,
		lineNumber: 89,
		columnNumber: 5
	}, this);
}
